# YouTube protocol profile attribution
Android request profile definitions adapted from youtube_explode_dart 3.1.0, lib/src/videos/youtube_api_client.dart.
Project: https://github.com/Hexer10/youtube_explode_dart ; BSD-3-Clause, Copyright 2021 Mattia. License reproduced here and bundled in Flutter assets.
Only fixed protocol context definitions adapted; no stream decipherer, SABR or library runtime copied or added. These profiles were validated by MediaFlow research on Windows/Android.
VISIONOS protocol profile is retained from MediaFlow research (protocol design reference: yt-dlp/YoutubeExplode), no implementation code copied from either project. Local request and response mapping are MediaFlow-owned, platform isolated.
